accounts.description: Specific accounts to sync. Must be populated if `syncMode` is set to `SpecificAccounts`.

rollback_window_size.description: A period of time in days during which a conversion is recorded.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific accounts. Default value: `AllAccounts`.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once the connector is created. Default value: `SIX`.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Microsoft Advertising client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Microsoft Advertising client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
